What We Do

What Ovira provides

Revenue Cycle Management is the main service — the full journey from first form to paid claim. Secure forms, compliant communications, and AI Scribe support it.

Revenue Cycle Management

Before you ask

Intake, eligibility checks, claim preparation, submission, tracking, denial follow-up, payment posting, and patient billing — as one service.
Patients get a secure link and complete the form on their phone or computer before the visit. Submissions are encrypted, and the details flow straight into billing — nothing typed twice.
The AI flags missing information and common denial triggers before submission, then tracks status and denial patterns after. Our team reviews flagged items — AI assists, people decide.
Yes — that is the point. Messages run through controlled channels with access limits, reviewed templates, and a full record, designed around HIPAA instead of personal devices.

Also Included

Compliant communications

Every message between your practice, patients, and payers — in one system: professional, traceable, and within the rules.

  • One system — appointments, billing questions, and follow-ups, never from personal phones.
  • HIPAA-minded — access controls, approved templates, and a full audit trail.
  • Nothing falls through — reminders go out on schedule; replies reach the right person.

How it flows: sent from one system → kept on the record → routed to the right person → followed up until the loop is closed.

Service 03

AI-Based Claims Management

AI reviews every claim before it goes out and tracks it after. Denials are corrected, resubmitted, and learned from.

Ask About Claims Management ← Back to Home
Automation network · One claim, every station

What it covers

  • Checked before submission — AI flags errors and missing information while they can still be fixed.
  • Every claim tracked — stalled claims get followed up, not forgotten.
  • Denials worked, patterns learned — denied claims are corrected, resubmitted, and fixed at the source.
Claim scrubbingDenial managementStatus trackingPayment posting

The life of a claim

1

Scrubbed

AI checks the claim before it leaves. Errors fixed first.

2

Submitted

Clean claims go out to the payer, complete.

3

Tracked

Status watched daily. Stalls get followed up.

4

Paid — or reworked

Payments posted. Denials corrected, resubmitted, and learned from.

Cleaner claims out. Fewer denials back.

Looking up a specific code? See our published notes in Resources.

Ask About Claims Management →
Watch It Work

One claim, station to station

No claim sits in a pile. Each automated station completes its step and hands the claim to the next — intake, client rules, submission, payer adjudication, and follow-up. Select any station to jump to it.

The handoff chain

The payer is shown as a generic node — the claim is worked the same careful way with every payer.

Claim
Intake receives the claim and validates the basics.

Every client, its own patient rules

There is no single standard rulebook. The rules are handled at ground level — the rules engine applies the patient rules of the client each claim belongs to.

    Example rule sets, shown to illustrate how per-client rules work. A practice's real rules are set together at onboarding — and the animation cycles through the clients so you can see the rules change.

    Privacy Policy

    SMS Messaging

    Last updated: October 26, 2026

    Ovira Health Systems offers an SMS messaging program for users who voluntarily opt in. By providing your phone number and checking the consent box on our sign-up form, you agree to receive text messages from us.

    • Message Frequency: Message frequency varies based on the type of communication
    • Rates: Message and data rates may apply
    • Opt-In: Users opt in by submitting our sign-up form and checking the consent box
    • Opt-Out: Reply STOP to any message at any time. You will receive a confirmation and no further messages will be sent
    • Help: Reply HELP for assistance, or contact us at [phone] or [email]
    • Carrier Disclaimer: Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages
    • Privacy: We value your privacy. Mobile information and SMS opt-in consent will not be shared with, sold to, or bought by any third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes

    For the terms that govern participation in this program, see our SMS Terms and Conditions.
